steps.label: Brief
steps.text:
CAMPAIGN BRIEF – Frescopa: Spring Campaign 2027
Goal: Launch Frescopa's spring 2027 push around Frescopa Go — our new lightweight, pause-anytime plan ($19/mo) — using the fresh-start energy of spring to drive sign-ups from flexibility-seeking first-timers who've held off on a bigger commitment.

Background: Frescopa (demo site) is a premium lifestyle brand built on one idea — "Everyday, elevated." Our plans range from Frescopa One ($49/mo, most complete) down to Flex and Duo. Frescopa Go is the newest and most flexible: lightweight, low-commitment, and pausable or switchable any month. Spring is the natural moment to introduce it — a season about fresh starts and low-stakes change — lowering the barrier to entry while keeping the Frescopa standard of care: member pricing, Care+ availability, and the freedom to upgrade whenever life changes.

Audience: Flexibility-first prospects — people who've browsed plans but balked at a monthly commitment, plus lapsed trialists. They value freedom, low risk, and "try before you commit" over premium bells and whistles.

Key message: "Start fresh this spring. Switch anytime. Stay as long as it works for you." Supporting point: No lock-in — pause or switch any month, and upgrade to a fuller plan whenever you're ready. 60-day free returns and 24/7 real help included.

Tone: Warm, confident, pressure-free. Lean into spring's sense of renewal and ease — freedom, not FOMO. No hype.

Call to action: Try Frescopa Go — $19/mo, cancel or pause anytime. (Secondary: Compare all plans.)

Deliverables:

Landing page – hero headline, short body copy (3 benefits), plan-comparison snippet (Go vs. Flex vs. One), one primary CTA, no hero image for first draft
Launch email – subject line, preheader, body copy, CTA
Social posts – 3 variants (LinkedIn, Instagram, X)
Timeline: Content drafted by end of week 1, reviewed by end of week 2, live by end of week 3.

Open items (to be clarified):

⚠ Confirm whether Care+ is included or add-on at the Go tier
⚠ CTA destination — /en/collections vs. a dedicated /en/products/frescopa-go page not decided
⚠ Pause/switch terms (max pause duration, re-activation) not finalized
⚠ Legal sign-off on "cancel anytime" claim pending
